question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(D\) is a point on \(AB\), \(\angle ACD=\angle B\), \(AD=4\), and \(AB=9\). Find the length of \(AC\).
solution: In \(\triangle ACD\) and \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle A\) is common and \(\angle ACD=\angle B\), so \(\triangle ACD\sim\triangle ABC\). Thus, \(AC/AB=AD/AC\), \(AC^2=AD\cdot AB=36\), and \(AC=6\).
